entities.name: Endometriosis
observations: Endometriosis-associated choriodecidual samples in a small human case-control study showed endometriotic-like glandular lesions along the decidual side of fetal membranes; clinical implications remain unknown.

entities.name: Choriodecidual lesions
observations: In term prelabor cesarean samples from 11 women with severe endometriosis versus 11 controls, endometriotic-like glandular components were reported on the decidual side of choriodecidua; anatomical subtype and functional consequences were not established.

entities.name: Parkinson disease
observations: Resting tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia, and shuffling gait are consistent with Parkinson disease. [source: call_ZsIcSpoimXmcKilOUjZBzs8M]

entities.name: Levodopa
observations: Levodopa crosses the blood–brain barrier and is converted to dopamine in the CNS; carbidopa increases its available fraction by reducing peripheral conversion. [source: call_wge61dzzShuL2Y1KuKiYjNyi]

entities.name: Carbidopa
observations: Carbidopa inhibits peripheral DOPA decarboxylase, increasing levodopa available for CNS entry and reducing peripheral dopaminergic adverse effects. [source: call_uj8vLFaPTjDy3kS9seqE61Cr]

entities.name: Carbidopa potentiates levodopa
observations: Carbidopa potentiates levodopa by inhibiting its peripheral metabolism, increasing effective CNS exposure; this is not antagonism or an additive independent effect. [source: call_wge61dzzShuL2Y1KuKiYjNyi]
